fields.hero_texto: We care for your well-being through science and technology to improve your quality of life.
fields.centro_titulo: The longevity center that focuses on you and your quality of life.
fields.centro_texto:
For decades we were taught to see a doctor when something hurts. At AETRA we believe in another way of taking care of yourself: understanding your body before it speaks, and listening carefully when it already does.

We practice precision medicine that is preventive, personalized and evidence-based. We do not promise eternal youth or universal formulas: we offer precise information about your body and a plan designed only for you.
fields.dra_titulo:
Dr. Paola Parra
and her approach.
fields.dra_texto:
With more than 20 years devoted to regenerative, integrative and longevity medicine, Dr. Paola Parra has helped thousands of patients understand their health in a more complete way.

Her approach combines clinical listening with the precision of measurement. For her, every patient is a unique story, not just another diagnosis.

fields.hero_titulo: The first longevity center in Colombia.
fields.mision_texto:
Over the years we have developed the AETRA Protocol, integrating some of the most advanced technologies in the world to bring to Colombia solutions that once seemed distant and required traveling abroad.

Longevity medicine is not only about adding years, but about living them with more health, energy, autonomy and quality of life. Our goal is to extend your healthspan: the years you can live with physical, mental and functional fullness.
fields.tecnologia_titulo: Diagnostic technology unique in the region.
fields.tecnologia_texto: We measure what others estimate. We integrate non-invasive assessments of 3D body composition, mineral profile and gut health so that decisions about your health are made with precise information, not assumptions.
fields.test_texto: Take a test and find some answers to take care of yourself and your years ahead.

fields.hero_titulo: Health, beauty and well-being in harmony.
fields.hero_texto: More than 20 years combining integrative, functional, quantum and holistic medicine in a single personalized approach.
fields.sobre_texto: I have devoted myself to deepening my medical knowledge to offer a unique experience of well-being and health. I am a medical doctor and I have brought together Integrative Medicine, Functional Medicine, Quantum Medicine, and Holistic and Allopathic Medicine to give each of my patients a complete and personalized approach.
fields.enfoque_pilares:
Integrative Medicine
Functional Medicine
Quantum Medicine
Holistic Medicine
Allopathic Medicine
fields.integrativa_titulo: What is functional and integrative medicine?
fields.integrativa_texto:
It is a medical approach that seeks to understand the origin of disease, not only to relieve its symptoms. Unlike conventional medicine, which often focuses treatment on the specific diagnosis or the present symptom, this model looks at the patient as a whole, understanding that all the body’s systems are connected.

Its goal is to identify the causes of the imbalance, restore the proper functioning of the body and promote a better long-term quality of life, with evidence-based therapies and advanced diagnostic support technology.
fields.integrativa_beneficios:
Seeking the root of the problem, not only controlling symptoms.
Reducing inflammatory processes.
Improving immune system function.
Optimizing metabolism.
Supporting hormonal balance.
Reducing chronic pain.
Improving sleep quality.
Increasing energy levels.
Supporting the body’s detoxification.
Improving gut health.
Complementing conventional medical treatments.
Promoting healthy aging.
Improving overall quality of life.
fields.cita_texto: “My work does not begin when illness appears. It begins when someone decides they want to understand their body.”
fields.cita_apoyo: Medical treatments do more than improve appearance: they transform health, mind and spirit, through a methodology refined over more than 20 years that combines science and technology for visible and lasting results.
fields.regenerativa_texto: If you are looking for a place where your health, your beauty and your well-being come together in harmony, I am the professional you need. Discover that we can work naturally with health and regenerative medicine, approaching anti-aging medicine from both the physical and the functional perspective.
fields.filosofia_texto:
Dr. Paola Parra’s philosophy of care is based on understanding that every patient is unique. That is why each treatment plan is built individually, combining clinical assessment, technological tools such as bioresonance and integrative therapies selected according to each person’s specific needs.

The goal is not only to relieve pain or control a disease, but to help the body regain its balance, improve its functioning and promote a better quality of life in a sustainable way.
fields.filosofia_nota: Integrative therapies complement medical care and must be prescribed by a health professional after an assessment.

fields.intro_texto: A team with global experience, ready to work with you from diagnosis to your treatment plan and its follow-up measurements.
fields.longevidad_texto: We integrate light therapy, molecular hydrogen and microcurrents to help reduce pain and inflammation, improve skin quality and sleep, and restore your daily energy. We also support healthy aging in processes associated with memory loss and chronic fatigue, always as part of an integrated plan.
fields.diagnostico_texto: We measure what others estimate. With non-invasive assessments of 3D body composition, vitamin and mineral profile and gut health, together with the bioresonance study as diagnostic support, you get data instead of impressions to design a more precise plan.

fields.hero_texto: We seek to understand the origin of disease, not only to relieve its symptoms. Learn about the conditions we treat and the therapies we integrate into your plan.
fields.enfermedades_texto: Functional and integrative medicine can be an excellent alternative or complement for patients who present:

fields.hero_titulo: The first step is listening to you.
fields.hero_texto: It is your starting point: a comprehensive consultation, measurements, a report and a plan.
fields.como_texto:
Every patient receives a fully personalized consultation that includes an in-depth assessment of factors like the ones you see here.

In addition to the traditional medical assessment, Dr. Paola Parra includes a bioresonance study, a technological tool that provides complementary information about how the body works and makes a much more precise and personalized treatment plan possible.
fields.como_nota: Bioresonance does not replace medical judgment or conventional clinical tests: it acts as diagnostic support.

fields.hero_texto: Answers to the most common questions about the assessment, longevity medicine and our therapies.

fields.banner_titulo: Start by knowing your starting point.

paso_1.texto: We assess your current state with precision technology and an in-depth medical consultation. Your story matters as much as your data.

paso_2.texto: We turn the results into clear information: what is fine, what deserves attention and why.

paso_3.texto: We build a personalized plan that may include nutrition, movement, rest, supplementation when indicated and supportive therapies.

paso_4.texto: We follow up, measure again and adjust. Your plan evolves with you.

fields.enfermedad_abordaje:
Every patient receives a fully personalized consultation, with an in-depth assessment of their medical history, eating habits, sleep quality, stress level, hormonal, metabolic and gut health, pain, inflammation and emotional state.

In addition to the traditional medical assessment, we include a bioresonance study as diagnostic support. With all this information we design an individual protocol that may combine different therapies, according to your needs.
fields.nota_terapias: Integrative therapies complement medical care and must be prescribed by a health professional after an assessment.
fields.aviso_legal: Results vary from person to person. Our services are complementary and do not replace the treatment prescribed by your physicians.

dolor-cronico.title: Chronic pain
dolor-cronico.excerpt: Fibromyalgia, muscle, joint and low back pain, migraines, headaches and tendinitis.
dolor-cronico.content:
Pain that persists over time rarely has a single cause. From functional and integrative medicine we look for the factors that sustain it —inflammation, muscle tension, changes in nervous system regulation, habits or stress— to treat its origin and not only control it.

We want you to know something from the start: we listen to you, what you feel is real and it makes sense to us.

fields.titulo_largo: Chronic pain: treating the cause, not just the symptom.
fields.entradilla: Living with pain changes the way you live every day. Many people come to us after years of appointments, tests and treatments that only partly helped.
fields.condiciones:
Fibromyalgia.
Muscle pain.
Joint pain.
Low back pain.
Migraines.
Headaches.
Tendinitis.
fields.seo_descripcion: Fibromyalgia, migraines, low back, muscle or joint pain: how AETRA’s functional and integrative medicine approaches chronic pain.

procesos-inflamatorios.title: Inflammatory processes
procesos-inflamatorios.excerpt: Chronic inflammation, persistent pain and complementary support for autoimmune diseases.
procesos-inflamatorios.content:
The integrative approach seeks to reduce inflammatory processes in the body and improve immune system function, understanding that all the body’s systems are connected.

In autoimmune diseases our work is complementary: we do not replace your specialists or the treatment you already receive, we support it to improve your well-being and quality of life.

fields.entradilla: Persistent inflammation can be behind pain, fatigue and general discomfort, even when conventional tests show no clear cause.
fields.condiciones:
Chronic inflammation.
Autoimmune diseases (as complementary support).
Persistent pain.
fields.seo_descripcion: Chronic inflammation, persistent pain and complementary support for autoimmune diseases with integrative medicine at AETRA.

trastornos-metabolicos.title: Metabolic disorders
trastornos-metabolicos.excerpt: Insulin resistance, prediabetes, diabetes, overweight, obesity and metabolic syndrome.
trastornos-metabolicos.content:
We assess your metabolic status, eating habits, body composition and energy level to identify what is causing the imbalance.

With that information we design a personalized plan that seeks to optimize your metabolism and, in the case of diabetes, complement the treatment prescribed by your physicians.

fields.titulo_largo: Insulin resistance, excess weight and metabolic health.
fields.entradilla: Your metabolism influences your energy, your weight and your long-term health. Understanding it is the first step to optimizing it.
fields.condiciones:
Insulin resistance.
Prediabetes.
Diabetes (as complementary treatment).
Overweight.
Obesity.
Metabolic syndrome.
fields.seo_descripcion: Insulin resistance, prediabetes, diabetes, overweight, obesity and metabolic syndrome: AETRA’s integrative approach.

alteraciones-hormonales.title: Hormonal imbalances
alteraciones-hormonales.excerpt: Menopause, perimenopause, adrenal fatigue, thyroid disorders and polycystic ovaries.
alteraciones-hormonales.content:
During the assessment we evaluate your hormonal status together with your metabolism, sleep quality, stress level and gut health, because hormonal balance depends on all of them.

The goal is to support hormonal balance within a comprehensive, personalized plan that complements the medical care you already receive.

fields.entradilla: Hormonal changes can affect your energy, sleep, weight and mood. You do not have to accept them as inevitable.
fields.condiciones:
Menopause.
Perimenopause.
Adrenal fatigue.
Thyroid disorders.
Polycystic ovary syndrome (as support).
fields.seo_descripcion: Menopause, perimenopause, adrenal fatigue, thyroid disorders and polycystic ovaries: integrative medicine at AETRA.

salud-digestiva.title: Digestive health
salud-digestiva.excerpt: Irritable bowel, recurrent gastritis, bloating, constipation and intestinal disorders.
salud-digestiva.content:
We assess your digestion, eating habits and possible food intolerances. When indicated, the breath test evaluates whether there is bacterial overgrowth in the small intestine, a condition associated with symptoms such as bloating.

With that information we design a plan aimed at improving your gut health and reducing inflammation.

fields.titulo_largo: Irritable bowel, gastritis and gut health.
fields.entradilla: Bloating, gastritis or irritable bowel are signs that your gut health needs attention, and they often affect your energy and overall well-being.
fields.condiciones:
Irritable bowel.
Recurrent gastritis.
Bloating.
Constipation.
Intestinal disorders.
fields.seo_descripcion: Irritable bowel, recurrent gastritis, bloating and constipation: how AETRA takes care of your gut health.

salud-emocional.title: Emotional health
salud-emocional.excerpt: Chronic stress, anxiety, fatigue, exhaustion and sleep disorders.
salud-emocional.content:
The assessment includes your emotional state, stress level, sleep quality and energy level, along with the rest of your medical history.

Depending on your needs, the plan may combine integrative therapies that help reduce anxiety and stress and promote rest.

fields.entradilla: Stress, anxiety and tiredness affect your body as much as your mind. That is why we address them as part of your health, not separately.
fields.condiciones:
Chronic stress.
Anxiety.
Fatigue.
Exhaustion.
Sleep disorders.
fields.seo_descripcion: Chronic stress, anxiety, fatigue, exhaustion and sleep disorders: AETRA’s comprehensive approach.

sistema-inmune.title: Immune system
sistema-inmune.excerpt: Low immunity, slow recovery and recurrent infections.
sistema-inmune.content:
Integrative medicine seeks to improve immune system function and stimulate the body’s natural defenses as part of a personalized plan.

We assess your medical history, nutrition, gut health and stress level, factors that directly influence your ability to defend yourself.

fields.entradilla: Getting sick often or taking a long time to recover may indicate that your immune system needs support.
fields.condiciones:
Low immunity.
Slow recovery.
Recurrent infections.
fields.seo_descripcion: Low immunity, recurrent infections and slow recovery: how AETRA strengthens your immune system.

ozonoterapia-mayor.title: Major ozone therapy
ozonoterapia-mayor.excerpt: One of the most widely used treatments in integrative medicine to reduce inflammation and support cellular oxygenation.
ozonoterapia-mayor.content:
What is it?

It is one of the most widely used treatments in integrative medicine.

A small amount of the patient’s blood is drawn, mixed with a controlled concentration of medical ozone and then reinfused into the body.

fields.beneficios:
Reduces inflammation.
Supports cellular oxygenation.
Stimulates the immune system.
Helps in chronic diseases.
Supports physical recovery.
Reduces oxidative stress.
Increases cellular energy production.
fields.indicaciones:
Chronic fatigue.
Fibromyalgia.
Inflammatory diseases.
Chronic pain.
Sports recovery.
Support in autoimmune diseases.
fields.seo_descripcion: What major ozone therapy is, its benefits and indications: inflammation, chronic fatigue, fibromyalgia and chronic pain.

ozonoterapia-menor.title: Minor ozone therapy
ozonoterapia-menor.excerpt: Stimulates and modulates the immune system through an intramuscular application of medical ozone.
ozonoterapia-menor.content:
What is it?

A small blood sample is taken from the patient, mixed with medical ozone and then applied through an intramuscular injection.

fields.beneficios:
Stimulates the body’s defenses.
Modulates the immune system.
Reduces inflammatory processes.
Supports the body’s recovery.
fields.indicaciones:
Allergies.
Low immunity.
Mild inflammatory processes.
Immune prevention and strengthening.
fields.seo_descripcion: What minor ozone therapy is, its benefits and indications: allergies, low immunity and mild inflammatory processes.

ozonoterapia-intrarrectal.title: Rectal ozone therapy
ozonoterapia-intrarrectal.excerpt: A comfortable, minimally invasive technique that supports gut health and oxygenation.
ozonoterapia-intrarrectal.content:
What is it?

It is a technique in which medical ozone is administered rectally using a specialized catheter.

It allows rapid absorption into the bloodstream without the need for intravenous procedures.

fields.beneficios:
Improves oxygenation.
Reduces inflammation.
Supports gut health.
Stimulates the immune system.
It is a comfortable, minimally invasive procedure.
fields.indicaciones:
Digestive diseases.
Intestinal inflammation.
Fatigue.
Chronic pain.
Maintenance therapies.
fields.seo_descripcion: What rectal ozone therapy is, its benefits and indications: gut health, inflammation, fatigue and chronic pain.

homosiniatria.title: Homosiniatry
homosiniatria.excerpt: Combines acupuncture with bioregulatory medicines to stimulate the body’s self-regulation.
homosiniatria.content:
What is it?

It is a technique that combines acupuncture with the application of bioregulatory or homeopathic medicines at specific points of the body.

Its goal is to stimulate the body’s natural self-regulation mechanisms.

fields.beneficios:
Reduces pain.
Reduces inflammation.
Supports muscle recovery.
Improves degenerative processes.
Stimulates the body’s capacity for repair.
fields.indicaciones:
Joint pain.
Muscle pain.
Tendinitis.
Muscle knots.
Sports injuries.
fields.seo_descripcion: What homosiniatry is, its benefits and indications: joint and muscle pain, tendinitis and sports injuries.

auriculoterapia.title: Auriculotherapy
auriculoterapia.excerpt: Stimulation of points on the outer ear to reduce stress and anxiety and promote rest.
auriculoterapia.content:
What is it?

It is a therapy based on stimulating specific points on the outer ear, which relate to different organs and systems of the body.

It can be performed with very fine needles, seeds or small therapeutic devices.

fields.beneficios:
Reduces anxiety.
Reduces stress.
Helps control appetite.
Promotes rest.
Complements pain treatments.
fields.indicaciones:
Stress.
Anxiety.
Insomnia.
Migraines.
Pain.
Weight control.
fields.seo_descripcion: What auriculotherapy is, its benefits and indications: stress, anxiety, insomnia, migraines, pain and weight control.

detox.title: Detox protocol
detox.excerpt: A 5-session protocol that supports the body’s natural detoxification processes.
detox.content:
What is it?

It is a 5-session protocol designed to support the body’s natural detoxification processes, combining different integrative therapies according to each patient’s medical assessment.

The treatment seeks to optimize the function of organs such as the liver, the intestine and the lymphatic system, promoting better metabolic balance.

fields.beneficios:
Supports the elimination of toxins.
Improves energy.
Reduces inflammation.
Improves digestion.
Supports metabolism.
Optimizes overall well-being.
fields.seo_descripcion: What AETRA’s detox protocol (5 sessions) is: it supports detoxification, energy, digestion and metabolism.

bioresonancia.title: Bioresonance study
bioresonancia.excerpt: A technological assessment that provides complementary information about how the body works.
bioresonancia.content:
What is it?

It is a technological assessment that analyzes different functional parameters of the body by measuring bioenergetic responses.

Its purpose is to provide information that complements the clinical examination, helping the physician identify possible imbalances in different body systems and design a more precise and personalized treatment plan.

What can it assess?

It can provide guidance on:

  • Nutritional status.
  • Vitamin and mineral balance.
  • Oxidative stress.
  • Metabolic function.
  • Digestive health.
  • Possible food intolerances.
  • Energy status.
  • Functional markers related to different body systems.

fields.beneficios:
Allows a more comprehensive assessment.
Helps personalize treatment.
Makes it easier to track the patient’s progress.
Complements the medical assessment.
fields.nota: Bioresonance does not replace conventional medical tests and is not a diagnosis on its own. It is used as a support tool within an integrative approach, always interpreted by the health professional together with the medical history and assessment.
fields.seo_descripcion: What the bioresonance study is, what it can assess and how it complements the medical assessment at AETRA.

biodescodificacion.title: Biodecoding consultation
biodescodificacion.excerpt: A 2-hour session to explore the link between emotions, life experiences and physical symptoms.
biodescodificacion.content:
What is it?

It is a 2-hour therapeutic space that explores the possible relationship between emotions, life experiences and the appearance of some physical symptoms, as a complement to comprehensive medical care.

During the session we help you identify emotional conflicts, behavior patterns and stress factors that could be affecting your well-being.

fields.beneficios:
Encourages self-knowledge.
Helps identify emotional patterns.
Complements comprehensive stress management.
May contribute to emotional well-being and adherence to medical treatment.
fields.nota: Biodecoding does not replace medical diagnosis or treatment. It is used as a complementary tool within an integrative approach.
fields.seo_descripcion: What the biodecoding consultation (2 hours) is: the link between emotions, experiences and symptoms, as a medical complement.

terapia-neural.title: Neural therapy
terapia-neural.excerpt: Regulates the autonomic nervous system to support the body’s self-regulation and recovery.
terapia-neural.content:
What is it?

It is a medical procedure that involves applying small amounts of local anesthetic, usually procaine, at specific points of the body —scars, nerve ganglia, muscles, joints or painful areas— in order to regulate the autonomic nervous system and support the body’s natural capacity for self-regulation and recovery.

In integrative medicine it is considered a tool that seeks to restore communication between the body’s systems when it has been disrupted by inflammation, trauma, surgery, infections or chronic disease. It does not act only where the pain is: it looks at the patient as a whole to identify possible interference fields.

How does it work?

The nervous system coordinates the functioning of all the body’s organs and tissues. When this regulation is disrupted, persistent symptoms such as pain, inflammation or organ dysfunction can appear.

By applying procaine at strategic points, neural therapy seeks to restore the balance of the nervous system, improve local circulation, reduce inflammation and stimulate the body’s natural repair mechanisms.

The procedure is performed by a trained physician, using very fine needles and safe doses of the medication, so it is usually well tolerated with a quick recovery.

Depending on the assessment, Dr. Paola Parra may combine it with ozone therapy, homosiniatry, auriculotherapy, detox protocols and functional medicine strategies.

fields.beneficios:
Helps reduce acute and chronic pain.
Contributes to reducing inflammatory processes.
Supports regulation of the autonomic nervous system.
Stimulates the body’s natural repair processes.
May improve mobility and the function of muscles and joints.
Integrates easily with other functional and integrative treatments.
Promotes a better quality of life by addressing the functional cause of some symptoms.
fields.indicaciones:
Chronic pain.
Fibromyalgia.
Neck and low back pain.
Migraines and headaches.
Neuralgia.
Tendinitis.
Plantar fasciitis.
Joint pain.
Sports injuries.
Pain after surgery or trauma.
Painful scars or scars considered interference fields.
Stress and functional disorders related to the autonomic nervous system.
fields.nota: Neural therapy must be performed exclusively by a trained physician. Like any medical procedure, it requires an individual assessment to determine whether it is suitable for each patient, and it is part of a comprehensive treatment plan.
fields.seo_descripcion: What neural therapy is, how it works, its benefits and indications: chronic pain, fibromyalgia, migraines, neuralgia and injuries.

preguntas: Does AETRA replace my specialists or the treatment I already receive?
No. We do not replace your specialists or the treatment you already receive: we complement it. When needed, we stay in touch with your physicians.
What is longevity medicine?

It is a preventive and personalized model of care whose goal is not only to live more years, but to live them with more health, energy, autonomy and quality of life. It seeks to identify risk factors early and optimize how the body works.
Who is longevity medicine for?

For people who want to take an active role in caring for their health: adults over 30 or 40, executives, athletes, entrepreneurs, people with a family history of chronic disease, or anyone who, even feeling healthy, wants to know the true state of their body.
What is functional and integrative medicine?
It is a medical approach that seeks to understand the origin of disease, not only to relieve its symptoms, looking at the patient as a whole because all the body’s systems are connected.
How long is the first visit?
You will spend 60 minutes with Dr. Paola Parra and the measurements indicated for your case.
Do I need to prepare for the assessment?
Yes. When you book, we send you instructions to prepare. Some assessments require fasting or specific preparation.
When do I get my results?
Within 5 business days you will have your results appointment. We will review your report together and give you a personalized plan.
Is bioresonance a diagnosis?

Not on its own. It is a support tool that provides complementary information; it does not replace conventional medical tests and is always interpreted by the health professional together with your medical history.
Is neural therapy safe?

It must be performed exclusively by a trained physician, with very fine needles and safe doses of the medication, so it is usually well tolerated. Like any medical procedure, it requires an individual assessment.
Which conditions can be treated?
We support chronic pain, inflammatory processes, metabolic disorders, hormonal imbalances, digestive health, emotional health and the immune system. Learn more in Conditions and therapies.
